decision: Do not expand the decoder broadly: it passes the RMSE gate in aggregate and is well above both gates on the other 27 held-out records when supplied exact native attention. The unchanged recurring outlier is associated with 30.38% unseen within-capability actions under only 30 training records per capability. Authorize one preregistered tenfold calibration-coverage oracle using already extracted records, preserving the 28 validation identities and every model setting.
claim_boundary: Read-only non-realizable layer-zero interface evidence only; exclusion statistics are diagnostic and do not change the locked fail decision. No extracted model, autonomous quality, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
